HINTS.EMAIL: Rich content, with editor and templates.

LIST.TITLE: Campaign

AUDIENCES.TITLE: Audience

AUDIENCES.ERROR: Could not delete the audience now.

PANEL.TITLE: Audience details
PANEL.CAMPAIGNS_NONE: No campaign used this audience yet.

NEW_AUDIENCE.TITLE: New audience
NEW_AUDIENCE.SUBTITLE: Upload the spreadsheet. We find the columns, the channels and the companies.
NEW_AUDIENCE.FROM_CAMPAIGN: You are creating an audience for the campaign "{name}". When you save it, we take you back to it.

NEW_AUDIENCE.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Car insurance renewals in October

NEW_AUDIENCE.CHECKING_HINT: This takes a few seconds. Nothing is saved yet.
NEW_AUDIENCE.REVIEW_SUBTITLE: Check before saving. Nothing goes into your contacts until you save.

COLUMNS.TITLE: Columns found

COLUMNS.NEED_CONTACT: Choose a mobile or an email column.
COLUMNS.OTHER_HINT: Kept to use in the message

CHANNELS.TITLE: Where you can reach these people
CHANNELS.HINT: Turned on by what the spreadsheet has. Turn a channel off if this audience is not for it.
CHANNELS.NO_EMAIL_HINT: The spreadsheet has no valid email.

CHANNELS.ERROR: Could not change it now. Try again.
CHANNELS.IN_USE: Campaigns still send to this audience on this channel: {campaigns}. Wait for them to finish or cancel them first.
CHANNELS.NO_INBOX_HINT: The account has no SMS inbox connected.

PEOPLE.PROBLEMS: row with a problem | rows with a problem
PEOPLE.LEFT_OUT: These rows are left out. Fix them and upload again when you want.
PEOPLE.NOT_RECEIVING_HINT: They stay in the audience but are left out of sends.

REASONS.NO_VALID_ROWS: No row has a valid mobile or email
REASONS.ROW_LIMIT: The spreadsheet has more rows than allowed

REFUSED.TITLE: No row can be used
REFUSED.HINT: Every row has a problem. Check the reasons, change the columns or upload another spreadsheet.

COMPANIES.TITLE: Companies
COMPANIES.HINT: The {column} column has each contact's company.
COMPANIES.OFF_HINT: No company will be created or linked.
COMPANIES.ERROR: Could not change it now. Try again.

NEW_AUDIENCE.SAVING_HINT: You can leave this page; saving continues.

FAILED.TITLE: The spreadsheet could not be read
FAILED.HINT: Upload it again. If it happens again, save it as CSV and try once more.

ERRORS.CREATE: Could not send the spreadsheet. Try again.
ERRORS.COLUMNS: Could not use these columns. Try again.
ERRORS.SAVE: Could not save the audience. Try again.

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Who will receive it
AUDIENCE.HINT: Choose an audience. The badges show where you can reach these people.
AUDIENCE.RETURNED: Done, we're back. The audience "{name}" was saved and is already selected.
AUDIENCE.EMPTY_TEXT: You don't have a list of people yet. Let's create the first one: just upload the spreadsheet. When you're done, we come back to this campaign.
AUDIENCE.NOT_FOUND: Didn't find who you're looking for?
AUDIENCE.NOT_FOUND_HINT: Create a new audience with a spreadsheet. Then we come back here.
AUDIENCE.LIVE_CHAT: Want an automatic message on your website, without a list of people?
AUDIENCE.LOAD_ERROR: The audiences could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

UNAVAILABLE.NO_SMS: This audience has no SMS on.
